Container.Name: wave-iphone
Container.Overview: Independent iPhone web player for SUB/WAVE with MP3, artwork and Media Session controls. Set SUBWAVE_URL to your existing SUB/WAVE server. iOS background metadata updates remain subject to browser suspension.

Config.Name: SUB/WAVE URL
Config.Description: Base URL reachable from this container, for example http://server-ip:7700 or https://radio.example.com (without /api or credentials). Change this when your upstream address changes.

Config.Name: Login enabled
Config.Description: Set true before internet access. Requires HTTPS origin, password hash and writable session storage.

Config.Name: Public HTTPS address
Config.Description: Example https://radio.example.com without trailing slash. Set together with WAVE_AUTH=true.

Config.Name: Password hash
Config.Description: Generate with: docker exec -it wave-iphone node password-hash.mjs. Store the hash here, never your password.

Config.Name: Login sessions
Config.Description: Persistent sessions. Directory must be writable by container UID 1000. Required when login is enabled.
